import ast
import base64
import hashlib
import json
from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path

def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def norm(x):
    y = x % 1
    return min(y, 1-y)

path = Path('research/astra-tight-seed-controls.json')
receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
assert sha(path.read_bytes()) == '1b45a4b38b4964ae192304f942aa00ed5a5e16089fb63d8a277548408b5de876'
source = receipt['frozen_source']
checker = Path(source['checker_path']).read_bytes()
assert sha(checker) == source['checker_sha256_before_execution']
assert sha(Path(source['plan_path']).read_bytes()) == source['plan_sha256_before_execution']
block = checker.decode().split('```python\n', 1)[1].split('\n```', 1)[0]
prefix = block.split('\nv=(1,4,5,6,7,11)', 1)[0].encode()
assert sha(block.encode()) == source['full_python_block_sha256_before_execution']
assert prefix == base64.b64decode(source['frozen_definition_prefix_base64'])
assert sha(prefix) == source['frozen_definition_prefix_sha256_before_execution']
recovered = receipt['execution_evidence_amendment']['recovery']
contents = {}
for name in ['actual_child_program', 'outer_inline_command', 'parent_harness']:
    contents[name] = base64.b64decode(recovered[name+'_utf8_base64'])
    assert len(contents[name]) == recovered[name+'_bytes']
    assert sha(contents[name]) == recovered[name+'_sha256']
assert sha(contents['actual_child_program']) == source['child_program_sha256']
assert recovered['outer_argv'][2].encode() == contents['outer_inline_command']
assert contents['outer_inline_command'].split(b"<<'PY'\n", 1)[1].rsplit(b'\nPY', 1)[0] == contents['parent_harness']
tree = ast.parse(contents['parent_harness'])
driver = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'driver' for t in n.targets))
assert prefix + b'\n' + driver.encode() == contents['actual_child_program']
provenance = recovered['provenance']
line = Path(provenance['transcript_path']).read_bytes().splitlines()[provenance['transcript_line']-1]
assert sha(line) == provenance['transcript_line_sha256']
event = json.loads(line)['payload']['item']
assert event['command'] == recovered['outer_argv']
assert event['exit_code'] == 0
assert json.loads(event['stdout'])['stdout_sha256'] == receipt['execution']['stdout_sha256']
execution = receipt['execution']
assert execution['child_exit_status'] == 0 and execution['parse_error'] is None
for name in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
    assert sha(execution[name].encode()) == execution[name+'_sha256']
assert execution['stderr'] == ''
assert json.loads(execution['stdout']) == receipt['results']
expected = [(1,3,4,7), (1,3,4,5,9), (1,4,5,6,7,11,13)]
for N,r,w in [(8,6,12),(14,12,24),(20,18,36),(26,24,48),(32,30,60),(32,30,90),(33,30,60),(38,36,72),(44,42,84)]:
    expected.append(tuple(sorted((set(range(1,N))-{r})|{w})))
records = receipt['results']['records']
assert receipt['results']['input_count'] == len(records) == 12
assert [tuple(r['tuple']) for r in records] == expected
label_count = 0
for r in records:
    v = r['tuple']; N = len(v)+1; delta = F(1,N); gamma = F(1,N-1)
    assert r['N'] == N and r['Q_succeeds'] and r['all_deletion_seed_sets_nonempty']
    assert len(r['per_label']) == len(v)
    for p,row in enumerate(r['per_label']):
        assert row['pivot_index'] == p and row['pivot_speed'] == v[p]
        assert row['seed_count'] == len(row['seed_intervals']) > 0
        s = F(row['attaining_time']); old = v[:p]+v[p+1:]
        assert all(norm(s*x) >= gamma for x in old)
        rho = min((norm(s*x)-delta)/x for x in old)
        assert norm(s*v[p])+v[p]*rho == F(row['score_maximum'])
        label_count += 1
    for key in ['full_1_over_N_witness', 'protected_witness']:
        w = r[key]; t = F(w['time']); norms = [norm(t*x) for x in v]
        assert norms == list(map(F, w['coordinate_norms']))
        assert min(norms) == F(w['minimum_norm']) >= delta
    w = r['protected_witness']; p = w['pivot_index']; s = F(w['seed_time'])
    rho = min((norm(s*x)-delta)/x for j,x in enumerate(v) if j != p)
    assert rho == F(w['rho'])
    assert abs(F(w['time'])-s) <= rho
    assert all(norm(s*x) >= gamma for j,x in enumerate(v) if j != p)
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed', 'receipt_sha256':sha(path.read_bytes()), 'fixed_inputs':len(records), 'attaining_label_records_checked':label_count, 'explicit_full_and_protected_witnesses_checked':2*len(records), 'all_real_interval_search_replayed':False, 'provenance':'Exact persisted execution transcript binds recovered full original driver; all source, byte, raw stream and result bindings checked.'}, sort_keys=True))
